newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Diebold buys Australia's Safetell Security.
newsitem.headline: Diebold buys Australia's Safetell Security.

text.p: Diebold Inc said on Monday that it had bought Melbourne-based security group Safetell International Security Ltd for an undisclosed amount.
Safetell makes security products and systems for banks and prisons such as access control and alarm monitoring security cameras.
Diebold chairman Robert Mahoney later told Reuters that Safetell has annual sales of about A$8.5 million.

Diebold said the takeover will raise its presence in Australia where it already serves more than 2,600 facilities varying from financial institutions, building societies and other cash handling premises.
It said Safetell has been renamed Diebold-Safetell and will operate as a wholly-owned unit of Diebold Australia Pty Ltd.
